title: Lesson 25: Performance Engineering for AI: Latency Budgets, Caching, Throughput, and Batching
description: Performance stops being about one query and becomes a system-wide budget the moment AI is in the path. This lesson covers latency budgets, the difference between throughput and latency, the batch that makes LLM inference affordable, and the caches that skip work entirely.
